hooks.prompt:
The following tool was just used: $ARGUMENTS

Check the file_path in the tool input. If it does NOT include a 'docs' directory segment (i.e., the file is not inside a docs/ folder), stop immediately and do nothing.

If the file IS inside docs/:
1. List every .md file currently in docs/
2. Read each one to understand what it documents (a sentence is enough)
3. Rewrite the ## Docs section in CLAUDE.md so it lists every doc file as a relative markdown link with a one-line description:
   - [`docs/filename.md`](docs/filename.md) — what this doc covers
4. Leave every other section in CLAUDE.md exactly as-is — only replace the lines between the ## Docs heading and the next ## heading
